prompts.heroes:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: production transparent 2D character turnaround sprite atlas for a cozy isometric Godot game.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its charming hand-drawn rounded cartoon linework, muted pastel flat watercolor fills, extremely simple tiny dark bean eyes with NO large white eyeballs, little expressive mouths, blush hatch marks, wobbly grey pencil contour, squishy irregular silhouettes and soft tufts. This must look like drawn comic characters, not smooth 3D figures or geometric primitives.
Create ONE 2048x2048 atlas, a strict uniform 4 COLUMN by 4 ROW grid of sixteen isolated full-body figures, equal 512x512 invisible cells, ample transparent gutters. No visible grid, lettering, labels, paper, white background, ground or cast shadows. Each character occupies about 70% of cell height, feet at same level, centred; no overlap.
Each ROW contains the SAME character in four consistent views: column 1 front (S), column 2 front three-quarter facing LEFT (SW), column 3 full left profile (W), column 4 back three-quarter facing LEFT (NW). Full body standing relaxed, no props covering face or hands. Keep body/clothes/colors/size identical across a row. No white die-cut border.
ROW 1: a very cute short round rust-orange fox with cream muzzle and belly, big soft pointed ears, two tiny charcoal oval eyes, tiny w mouth, peach cheeks, small mitten paws, two little brown feet, large soft bushy cream-tipped tail, no clothing.
ROW 2: a tiny meadow fairy girl, pale skin, tousled honey-blonde bob and small bun, sage green petal dress, small feet and arms, lavender translucent butterfly wings, blush and happy small mouth; head much larger than torso.
ROW 3: a tiny barefoot hobbit child with messy chestnut curls drawn in organic locks, moss-green tunic and dark olive shorts, small pointed ears, tiny dark bean eyes and smiling mouth, blushing cheeks, two stubby bare feet.
ROW 4: a fairy mayor lady with slightly wavy lavender bob, sage teal long petal coat and lavender butterfly wings, a small brass leaf brooch, kind smiling eyes, small hands, soft pear-shaped body, no crown.
Lighting: flat softly painted comic illustration, very subtle shading only. Avoid rendered spheres, cylinders, glossy 3D eyes, realistic anatomy, plastic, faceted shading, thick black outlines, gradients and icon style. Follow the first user reference closely.

prompts.nature:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent isometric nature and village prop atlas for a cozy illustrated game.
Reference is for hand-painted material detail, lush foliage and warm lived-in mood. Create a 2048x2048 square RGBA image, a precise 3x3 invisible equal-cell grid of NINE isolated full objects, one per cell, all transparent surroundings. No ground plane or island, no visible grid, labels, text, watermarks, no cast shadows, no white sticker border. Objects must fit entirely inside cells with clear gutters. Orthographic isometric camera 36 degrees above horizontal. Soft daylight upper left. Fine wandering warm grey-brown outlines, watercolor/gouache and brush-painted material, elegant organic silhouettes. Avoid geometric circles for foliage and triangles for pine. Every tree has hand-drawn branching limbs and many irregular leaf clusters.
TOP ROW left to right: 1) a lush broad old woodland oak with twisting warm brown trunk, spreading irregular branches and intricately painted sage/lime green small leaves, a few hanging vines, visible roots; 2) a flowering cherry tree with branching dark trunk, fluffy irregular pink and lavender blossom sprays and individual petal accents, visible roots; 3) a tall slightly crooked dark evergreen pine with organically drooping needle boughs and textured brown trunk, moss on roots.
MIDDLE ROW: 4) a low bush of many small sage leaves, tiny white flowers and dark berries, ragged natural contour; 5) a cluster of three rounded weathered grey rocks with moss, little ferns and cracks, natural soft stone; 6) an old warm copper street lantern hanging from a hooked carved timber post, amber glass, small climbing ivy at foot, enough fine construction detail to feel handmade.
BOTTOM ROW: 7) a weathered wooden farm fence segment with two wonky posts and two irregular horizontal rails, wood grain and little vine, running from upper LEFT to lower RIGHT in isometric projection; 8) a gentle handmade scarecrow in patched blue linen shirt and floppy straw hat, stitched smiling cloth face, on a single pole, outstretched sleeves, wisps of straw and tied scarf; 9) a rustic wooden signpost with two small blank arrow planks and tied cord, little leaves at base, no lettering.

Attached reference is the required MATERIAL, DRAWING and ARCHITECTURAL style: densely detailed painted miniature architecture, crooked timber, worn stone/plaster, many individual overlapping tiles, pipes, balconies, potted plants and vines, fine warm-grey drawing, watercolor/gouache hand-painted light, rich lived-in little details. Avoid bare plain cubes or geometric primitives.
Create one square 2048x2048 transparent RGBA sheet with FOUR independent complete structures, in a strict 2x2 invisible grid. One structure in each equal cell, ample transparent gutters, no overlap, no clipping, no background, no ground plane or island, no cast shadow, no white border, no text or watermark. Consistent orthographic isometric perspective, about 36deg camera elevation, front door facade visible on LEFT and right side on RIGHT, verticals upright. Soft daylight from upper left. Buildings must be complete through their front doorsteps. TOP LEFT: a humble little patched wooden lean-to shed with wonky rough boards, patched mossy tarp roof, stovepipe, small warm wooden door on LEFT front face, tiny amber window, stacked logs, a bucket and little herb pot. Very modest first home.
TOP RIGHT: a small honey-coloured log cottage with stone chimney, crooked porch roof and warm front door on LEFT facade, copper rain pipe, teal shutters, potted plants and stacked firewood.
BOTTOM LEFT: a cream plaster cottage with a thick soft golden thatched roof, eyebrow dormer, crooked timber trim, little porch with warm door on LEFT facade, copper pipe, amber windows, ivy and flowerpots.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a charming half-timber house with rich irregular dark beams, warm cream plaster, red terracotta overlapping roof tiles and cross gable, stone chimney, little balcony, warm front door on LEFT face, ivy, flower boxes and worn stone steps.

prompts.backs1:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent NORTH-FACING BACK VIEW character sprites for an existing cozy game cast.
Image 1 is the user's cartoon style reference. Images 2 through 5 are FOUR existing character turnaround atlases. Each source atlas has four characters in four ROWS, and different views in columns.
Draw exactly SIXTEEN complete, isolated, FULLY REAR FACING sprites in a precise 4x4 invisible grid on a square transparent canvas, ideally 2048x2048. No character looks sideways: all are facing directly away from the camera, back of head centred over body, both ears visible equally when possible, no face or eyes visible, no three-quarter view. Keep each character's existing identity, proportions, outfit, hair/fur colors, wings and tail design consistent with the supplied source atlas. Same grey hand-drawn contour and soft pastel comic finish, no 3D rendering. Full body including feet, ample clear transparent gutters, no clipping, ground, cast shadows, labels, visible grid, text or white border.
OUTPUT ROW 1, left to right: the FOUR characters from input image 2, in their original top-to-bottom character order.
OUTPUT ROW 2: the FOUR characters from input image 3, in top-to-bottom character order.
OUTPUT ROW 3: the FOUR characters from input image 4, in top-to-bottom character order.
OUTPUT ROW 4: the FOUR characters from input image 5, in top-to-bottom character order.
These are new exact-back view sprite assets, not a reproduction of the input turnaround grids. All sixteen figures MUST face straight away, backs to the viewer. Keep small bodies, large soft heads, irregular hair/fur tufts and fine gently wobbly warm-grey comic linework.
